(CURRENTLY AMENDED) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments and is positioned along the axial length of the conduit.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 32 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 33 wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length of the conduit.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 34 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism configured to facilitate engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity via the esophagus, and wherein the retrieval device is configured to interact with the coupling mechanism in a manner specified for this purpose.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 35 wherein the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon, and wherein at least one of the balloons includes a layer made from a biocompatible polymer.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 36 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about 20-40 mm.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 41, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state.  

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein: the first lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the first balloon; and the second lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the second balloon.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 43 wherein the third lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to a second end of the conduit.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 44, further comprising a coupling mechanism at the first end of the conduit, wherein the coupling mechanism is configured for instrument throughput into the third lumen and configured to couple to a delivery catheter and/or a filling tube.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 45 wherein the gastric space filler system is configured for delivery through an esophagus of a patient to a stomach of the patient.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 46 wherein the conduit is configured for attachment to a delivery catheter, and wherein the third lumen of the conduit is configured to receive an instrument passed through the delivery catheter.
